Once upon a time a little red Hen lived on a farm.
She shared her house with a lazy Dog, a sleepy Cat and a noisy Duck.
The Hen worked hard every day, but the others did nothing at all.
One morning Hen found some grains of wheat.
Who will help me plant this wheat?
said Hen.
Not I,
said Dog.
said Cat.
said Duck.
Then I will do it myself,
And she did.
The wheat grew tall and golden.
Who will help me cut the wheat?
Next it was time to take the wheat to the mill.
Who will help me grind the wheat into flour?
Hen took the flour home.
Who will help me bake the bread?
Soon the little house smelled of warm, fresh bread.
The Dog, the Cat and the Duck came running into the kitchen.
Who will help me eat the bread?
I will!
No, you will not,
I planted the wheat, I cut it, I ground it and I baked the bread.
Now I will eat it myself, with my little chicks.
Dog, Cat and Duck hung their heads.
They had not helped at all.
The next day Hen found more wheat.
And this time they did, and they shared the bread together.
